channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about David Griffin | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about David Griffin from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gayle Benson on David Griffin
item.description:
The New Orleans Pelicans have parted ways with Executive Vice President of Basketball Operations David Griffin, it was announced today by Pelicans Governor Gayle Benson.

“After considerable thought and evaluation, I have decided to relieve David Griffin of his duties as executive vice president of basketball operations,”

Gayle Benson on David Griffin, Apr 14, 2025. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: JJ Redick on David Griffin, Aaron Nelson, Courtney Kirkland
item.description:
“We’re getting ready to go out finally to the hallway, to do our prayer, go out for warmups, and Aaron Nelson sprints through the locker room to try to find David Griffin. And that’s when we found out Courtney Kirkland had reffed the Jazz game,”

JJ Redick on David Griffin, Aaron Nelson, Courtney Kirkland, Mar 23, 2020. Source: SportsNet.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on David Griffin
item.description:
Oleh Kosel:Trajan Langdon on whether the Brooklyn Nets could have retained him:

“My intrigue about this job {in New Orleans} was going to work with David Griffin.”

Trajan Langdon on David Griffin, May 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @OlehKosel.

item.title: Trajan Langdon on David Griffin
item.description:
Trajan Langdon on one #Pelicans objective:

“The main thing we need to do is continue to bring in the right people, and create a culture that attracts players who want to be here. As (David Griffin) has said in the past, we want players who are all in on New Orleans.”

Trajan Langdon on David Griffin, May 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on David Griffin
item.description:
“[Pelicans executive vice president of basketball operations David Griffin] took me in a conference room after his introduction [in April] and said, ‘We’re gonna win the lottery,’”

Alvin Gentry on David Griffin, May 15, 2019. Source: West Australian.

item.title: LeBron James on Charles Barkley, David Griffin
item.description:
James said of his role with the Cavs.

“There's the owner, Griff's [David Griffin] the GM, I'm the player. Screw Charles Barkley.”

LeBron James on Charles Barkley, David Griffin, Jan 31, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: LeBron James on David Griffin
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:LeBron on David Griffin:

“I think he was right on everything he said ... Like it or love it or hate it, we got to respect it”

LeBron James on David Griffin, Jan 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Dan Gilbert on David Griffin, Nathan Forbes
item.description:
Brian Windhorst:Dan Gilbert joked at season ticket event tonite:

“I gave (GM) David Griffin & (part owner) Nate Forbes unlimited budget & they exceeded it”

Dan Gilbert on David Griffin, Nathan Forbes, Oct 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @WindhorstESPN.
